Emit one stable, reproducible manifest stream from helm template,
install/upgrade dry-run, and helm get manifest, without new flags.

- Documents ordered lexicographically by full Source path; hooks included
- Multi-document YAML keeps rendered top-to-bottom order within a file
- Dry-run output shows a single MANIFEST section with no extra blank lines
- get manifest places hooks before non-hooks sharing a Source path
- helm template output ends with a trailing newline
- upgrade dry-run no longer prints the Happy Helming! success line"
